Energy Reserve Margin settings (used when ERM opt is enabled). Requires a feasible reserve state at every timestep that serves each bus its demand plus, in aggregate over each region, that region's reserve margin.

Reserve margin as a fraction (e.g., 0.15 for 15%) applied to the region's *total* demand. The reserve state must balance at every bus, but the requirement is only enforced on the regional sum, so intra-regional transmission earns no adequacy value -- use finer regions where that matters. Use ``all`` for one system-wide region, or specify region codes (state, interconnect, NERC region, or ReEDS zone). Each region gets its own constraint row and one shared reserve state satisfies all of them simultaneously. Defaults to ``all: 0.15`` if not specified.
